notes: From the table, it is seen that among the total inmates, undertrials
constitute the major portion of the prison population during 1997. All the 30
States and UTs except A&N Islands which had undertrial prisoners reported very
high proportion of such prisoners. In general, the percentage of undertrials to total
jail inmates ranged from 57.5% to 97.2%. The lowest percentage of under trial
prisoners was reported from A&N Isiands (38.9%). The percentage of Lunatics
was considerably low in the country. The maximum percentage of 0.8 of such
inmates was reported from A&N Islands.
